	method (TypeMod) String() string

# Types declared in unexported packages that the public API exposes.
# Reaching one of these means its shape is part of the contract, whatever
# package it lives in. Adding a method to one is a public API change.

reachable github.com/AlexAli29/orm/internal/expr.AliasCollisionError
  struct
  field Alias string
  field First *Source
  field Second *Source
  method Error() string

reachable github.com/AlexAli29/orm/internal/expr.LockStrength
  uint8
  method String() string

  struct
  field Column string
  field Source *Source
  field Visible []*Source
  method Error() string
